title: Opportunities
description: Partner jobs that fit your candidates. Submit someone and follow it in Referrals sent; you earn a share of the fee when they're hired.

review.label: To review
review.hint: New and undecided matches. Submit, save for later, or mark as not a fit.

saved.label: Saved
saved.hint: Your shortlist. Matches you want to come back to.

dismissed.label: Dismissed
dismissed.hint: Matches you marked as not a fit. Restore one if things change.

not_eligible.label: Not eligible
not_eligible.hint: A must-have isn't met, like a required language or location. Shown so you know why.

inactive.title: Turn on matching to see opportunities
inactive.description: None of your candidates are matching yet. Open a candidate, record their permission and turn on matching. Partner jobs that fit will show up here.

caughtUp.title: You're all caught up
caughtUp.description: Every match has a decision. We check automatically whenever a partner publishes a job or you update a candidate, and we'll show new matches here.

none.title: No matches yet
none.description: We check automatically whenever a partner publishes a job or you update a candidate. New matches will show up here.

saved.title: Nothing saved
saved.description: Use Save on a match to build a shortlist you can come back to.

dismissed.title: Nothing dismissed
dismissed.description: Matches you mark as not a fit end up here, so you can restore them later.

not_eligible.title: Nothing blocked
not_eligible.description: None of your matches are ruled out by a must-have requirement.

share.title: Your estimated share of the placement fee if this candidate is hired

sheet.descriptionHidden: The full description is shared once you submit a candidate.

triage.savedToast: Saved. Find it under Saved when you're ready to submit {name}.
triage.notFitAria: Mark {name} for {job} as not a fit
triage.why: Why? This helps improve your matches.
triage.dismissedToast: Dismissed. You'll find it under Dismissed if you change your mind.

review.title: Review match
review.heading: Review match & submit
review.gapsToDiscuss: Gaps to discuss with the candidate

evidence.matchingOff: Matching is turned off for this candidate
evidence.permissionMissing: The candidate's permission hasn't been recorded
evidence.jobClosed: Job is not open to external referrals
evidence.relocationRequired: Job requires presence in {country}; candidate is not open to relocation
evidence.noRequiredSkills: Job lists no required skills; relevance is approximate
evidence.noRequiredSkillsPresent: None of the job's required skills are present
evidence.seniorityOneAbove: Seniority is one level above the role ({candidateSeniority} vs {jobSeniority})
evidence.seniorityOneBelow: Seniority is one level below the role ({candidateSeniority} vs {jobSeniority})
evidence.remoteCompatible: Remote role compatible with candidate preferences
evidence.relocationOpen: Would require relocation (candidate is open to it)
evidence.salaryFits: Salary expectation fits the compensation band
evidence.salaryAbove: Salary expectation is ~{percent}% above the band
evidence.currencyMismatch: Compensation in different currencies; not compared

panel.private: Hidden from the hiring recruiter until you submit.
panel.scoreInfo: Fit score from skills, seniority, location and pay. Not a hiring prediction. Updated {time}.
